decisions.quote: In line with a previous ERP study11, the OLP reduced the LPP amplitude in a centroparietal cluster to both neutral and negative stimuli. In the present experiment, the early LPP amplitude (400–1000 ms) was lower in the OLP group compared to the control group. In contrast, Guevarra et al.11 detected the placebo effect in the late LPP window (1000–6000 ms after picture onset).
decisions.reason: The authors report no overall replication verdict and explicitly mark part of their findings as agreeing with Guevarra et al. (reduced emotional distress and centroparietal LPP reduction) while contrasting the LPP timing (early 400–1000 ms vs. the original's late 1000–6000 ms window, which was only marginally significant here), making the outcome mixed under the codebook.
